images.title: BYE × 6 = RAY solved
images.purpose: Shows the solved puzzle 105 × 6 = 630 with each letter matched to its digit.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two lines of large text, the letter line above the digit line, aligned character by character.
images.exact_structure: Top line in teal (#0072B2) text: BYE × 6 = RAY. Directly below, in amber (#E69F00) text, aligned so each digit sits under its letter: 105 × 6 = 630 (1 under B, 0 under Y, 5 under E, 6 under R, 3 under A, 0 under the second Y). The two Y letters and the two 0 digits under them each sit inside a small reddish purple (#CC79A7) outlined rounded box, so exactly 4 boxes. Nothing else in the frame.
